decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program builds directly on the firm's own manufacturing and logistics knowledge, so its results are easy to read and improve, though it may be merged into the broader express program.

The 72-hour delivery draws on the firm's established spare-parts and production logistics capability, but it is only mentioned on the website and is costly to operate, so consolidation into Product D is a modest risk.
The express program for doors and gates has its own page in both years and rests on core process knowledge the firm can readily assimilate and refine.
The online ordering and digital services platform fits the firm's move toward deeper service and advisory support, and its usage data give rich feedback the firm can learn from.

The fire and smoke protection door is a core competency backed by in-house R&D and certification know-how, and it was upgraded to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment after Product C was consolidated.
